title: Contact/set and Message/set destroy filter_map silently drops non-string IDs
description: In contact.rs line 160-165 and message.rs line 171-177, destroy IDs are collected via filter_map which silently drops non-string values. RFC 8620 section 5.3 requires every submitted destroy ID to appear in either destroyed or notDestroyed. A non-string destroy ID (e.g. an integer) is silently discarded: it appears in neither list. Callers cannot detect the error. Fix: reject non-string entries with a method-level invalidArguments error, or iterate with a proper error return matching how Chat/set and the ids arrays in /get handlers work.
